=== CSCI 1260 GUIS AND EVENTS LAB ===

Part A: the coffee bar announces
  Place Ada, latte:               #1 Ada, latte
  Place Ben, mocha:               #2 Ben, mocha
  Place a blank name:             refused: Customer name is required.
  OrderPlaced heard:              #1 (waiting 1), #2 (waiting 2)
  FinishNext:                     #1 Ada, latte
  AllCaughtUp heard:              0 times
  FinishNext:                     #2 Ben, mocha
  AllCaughtUp heard:              1 time
  OrderReady heard:               #1 (waiting 1), #2 (waiting 0)
  FinishNext when empty:          refused: No orders are waiting.

Part B: listeners
  Pickup screen:
    Ready: #1 Ada
    Ready: #2 Ben
    Ready: #3 Cy
  Buzzer, disconnected after #1:
    Buzz: Ada, your latte is ready.
  Rewards, Cy orders three times:
    Drinks for Ada, Cy:           1 3
    FreeDrinkEarned heard:        Cy on #4

Part C: the window
  Place Ada, latte:               #1 Ada, latte
  Boxes after Place:              (blank) (blank)
  Place Ben, mocha:               #1 Ada, latte | #2 Ben, mocha
  Click Ready:                    #1 Ada
  Click Ready again:              #1 Ada | #2 Ben
  Waiting list:                   (empty)
  Status:                         All caught up.

Part D: buttons that know when they can work
  Place enabled, boxes empty:     False
  Place enabled, name only:       False
  Place enabled, name and drink:  True
  Ready enabled, none waiting:    False
  Ready enabled, one waiting:     True
  Ready enabled, all finished:    False
  Reward text:                    Free drink earned: Cy
